body:
INFUSED XORN CR 9

XP 6,400
N Medium outsider (earth, extraplanar)
Init +1, Senses Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 11, flat-footed 22 (+12 natural, +1 Dex)
hp 138 (12d10 +72)
Fort +14, Ref +4, Will +6; DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune cold, fire, flanking; Resist electricity 10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., burrow 20 ft., earth glide
Melee 4 bites +15 (3d6 +4)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 13, Con 22, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 9
Base Atk +12; CMB +17, CMD 28

SPECIAL ABILITIES

All-Around Vision (Ex)

A xorn sees in all directions at the same time, giving it a +4 racial bonus on Perception checks. A xorn cannot be flanked.

Earth Glide (Ex)

A xorn can glide through any s ort of natural earth or stone as easily as a fish swims through water. Its burrowing l eaves no sign of its passage nor hint at its presence to creatures that don’t possess tremorsense.

A move earth spell cast on an area containing a xorn moves the xorn back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.

Made of Teeth (Ex)

Unlike a normal Xorn, the Infused Xorn has grown mouths on its claws and all over its body (noted above in its attacks). When an infused xorn is struck with a weapon, it manifests a mouth a round the weapon.

The item takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage. If the item reaches a -5 penalty, the weapon is destroyed. Magic items are destroyed when the penalty reaches -7.

Arcane Reflection (Su)

When the infused xorn is struck by a magic spell, it explodes energy outward. All creatures within a 20-foot radius suffer 3d6 force damage. Creatures other than itself can make a DC 15 Reflex save for half damage.
